name: safari-mockup
blurb: SVG Safari browser mockup frame with address bar and chrome controls.
description: An SVG component rendering a Safari browser window chrome, optionally displaying a screenshot image inside the viewport and a URL in the address bar.
use_when: Showcasing website or app screenshots in product demos, marketing materials, or design presentations.
avoid_when: When you need an interactive browser or actual navigation — this is a static mockup.
a11y: SVG element with presentational graphics. Does not provide semantic meaning.
